type Config struct {
	Command string
	Args    []string
	Cwd     string
	Env     map[string]string

	StdinFile *os.File

	ReadFiles []*os.File

	DirectoryFiles []*os.File
}

type Process struct {
	Stdin  io.WriteCloser
	Stdout io.ReadCloser
	Stderr io.ReadCloser
}

type StreamLine struct {
	Data                []byte
	Complete, Truncated bool
}

var ErrLineLimit = errors.New("native stream line exceeds explicit byte limit")

var SafePath = func() string { path, _ := windows.GetSystemDirectory(); return path }()
